This intriguing specimen reveals a volcanic history intertwined with water activity, indicating a complex water cycle on Mars. As researchers delve deeper into its origins, they are unraveling vital insights into the planet's early environmental conditions.

description: Cyclone Arnab hit the coast of Andhra Pradesh this week. In preparation, authorities evacuated people, halted transportation services and alerted disaster response forces. This is just the first cyclone of the northeast monsoon season. As climate change threatens to bring increasingly intense cyclones and other natural disasters, will India’s current disaster management programme be able to handle the social and economic costs I?n this episode, Sonikka Loganathan speaks to Safi Ahsan Rizvi, former Adviser to the National Disaster Management Authority, about what goes into disaster management, the costs to the economy and vulnerable populations, and how India has improved its strategy since 1999.

Contributing over half a billion dollars to Republican-affiliated groups, Musk raises alarms about the implications of a Democratic majority. His fears encompass potential expansions of the Senate and the granting of statehood to Washington, D.C. and Puerto Rico.

title: Zakir Naik gets schooled by Malala's father for defending Taliban on girls' education

The spokesperson of the Taliban said the situation there (in Afghanistan) is not very safe for women." The fugitive preacher said a Talibani ambassador assured him lesser restrictions when "safety is secured".

Binance replenishes 90% of stolen crypto, says it will absorb financial losses
description: In a commendable move, Binance has restored 90 percent of the cryptocurrency assets lost due to a recent security breach. The exchange has pledged to handle the financial repercussions internally, ensuring customers are unaffected. Withdrawals are set to resume on Sunday, November 1, as Binance reinforces its commitment to transparency regarding its reserves.

title: 'Secret meets on foreign soil': PM Modi says opposition conspiring to divide nation
description: Accusing opposition of ripping apart the dignity and boundaries of the Constitution, PM Modi said: "Social media is being weaponised to spread rumours and to malign India's image. The citizens of the country must handle this together. We have eliminated Naxalism in far-flung areas, but the threat of 'Dimagi Naxalism' has not yet been averted from the nation."

title: Haunted, but hardly explored: India's untapped ghost-tourism economy
Sanjay Gupta's last rites held at Versova crematorium: Celebs arrive to pay last respects
description: The film industry is mourning the sudden loss of filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, who died after suffering a head injury at his residence in Mumbai. Tributes have flooded in from fellow artists and friends, underscoring his significant influence on their careers. At his funeral held at the Versova crematorium, close associates like Sanjay Dutt and Milap Zaveri reflected on Gupta's remarkable contributions, leaving the cinema world facing a profound loss.

title: Narang, Usha, Nehwal among 27 names in Draft List for IOA SOM Elections
description: The draft list of nominations has been released for the 2026 IOA Sportspersons of Outstanding Merit (SOM) elections, scheduled for November 9. The list contains 27 candidates—15 men and 12 women—including prominent sporting names such as Gagan Narang, PT Usha, Saina Nehwal, Yogeshwar Dutt and Anju Bobby George.

title: 'Musalmaan hone ki saza': Azam Khan arrested by ED minutes after he gets out of jail
description: Azam Khan was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate just after being released from Rampur jail. He had spent nearly 11 months in custody due to legal issues. His son, Abdullah Azam, was released simultaneously but was not taken into custody. The arrest relates to a 2019 case involving allegations of financial wrongdoing and land-grabbing activities. Khan responded emotionally, asserting that his arrest is due to his identity as a Muslim.

Island nation’s treaty with Australia raises concerns over loss of cultural heritage
description: Tuvalu's recent treaty with Australia allows its citizens to migrate for work and study opportunities abroad. While migration offers new options, concerns exist regarding the preservation of cultural heritage. Traditional buildings and construction skills might be at risk as populations shift. Researchers are documenting Tuvalu's architectural history through photographs and digital models. Decisions on migration and land use should integrate considerations of cultural heritage and community identity.

title: Australia hammered by Harmer in Cape Town as South Africa take series 2-1
description: Chasing a target of 288, Australia were bowled out for 111 in the second session on the final day. The result also took South Africa above Australia to the top of the Test world rankings for the first time since January 2016.

title: Ireland's Indian-origin pacer Moondra creates cricket history with 6/26 figures
description: Ireland pacer Jai Moondra made history against Namibia in the fourth ODI, taking six wickets for just 26 runs in 10 overs. His performance set a new record for Ireland’s best bowling figures in international cricket, surpassing Josh Little’s 6/36. Ireland won the match by 130 runs to level the five-match series 2-2, with the decider scheduled for Sunday.

title: Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany bring holiday joy to Kansas City families
description: In December 2023, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes rallied together for EarlyStart's Clothing Kits for Kids campaign, aimed at aiding Kansas City families with much-needed winter apparel. Their charity, 15 and the Mahomies, generously provided several clothing kits to those in need. A thankful mother applauded the couple's dedication to supporting children and schools throughout the festive season, highlighting the event's role in fostering community solidarity.

title: Kim Jong Un's cyber army: How North Korea's hackers steal billions for regime
description: North Korea has developed a sophisticated cyberwar machine enabling it to target financial institutions worldwide. The country's state-sponsored hackers increasingly rely on social engineering and malware to infiltrate cryptocurrency companies. Cyber operations are essential for generating funds due to international sanctions and economic isolation. Reports suggest that North Korea has stolen billions in cryptocurrency through extensive cybercriminal activity. These actions directly support its military programs and other state priorities.

title: 'Won't forgive and forget': Rahul Gandhi at CEC's 'public impeachment' event
Jewish banker's heirs sue Sotheby's over £1.2m 'Nazi-looted' painting
description: A prized artwork by Camille Pissarro is embroiled in a contentious legal battle initiated by the heirs of Salomon Flavian. They assert that the piece was taken by the Nazis during WWII and argue that they were not adequately involved in a prior settlement. Sotheby’s counters, insisting the sale was aboveboard and legally sound. This dispute highlights ongoing hurdles in recovering Holocaust-era property and ensuring rightful family representation.

title: ‘1984 anti-Sikh riots had no justification’: Hardeep Puri ahead of 42nd anniversary
description: Union minister Hardeep Singh Puri spoke out about the lasting impact of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, firmly stating that no justification exists for the violence inflicted upon the Sikh community. He lamented the tragic toll and enduring pain endured by victims while commending HS Phoolka's tireless efforts for justice. The fight for accountability persists as the search for answers continues decades later.

title: 82% disapprove of Trump. So why are fewer Indian Americans identifying as Democrats?
description: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, fresh polling shows Indian-Americans strongly favour Democrats on the economy and in congressional races. But a six-year decline in Democratic identification, growing political exhaustion and dissatisfaction with both parties suggest a more complicated relationship with the party.

title: IIT-Bombay suicide case: Sahil’s parents seek CBI probe, CCTV, witness protection
description: Parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, have petitioned for an independent investigation into his death. They allege that their son faced harassment and caste-based humiliation from a professor. The petition seeks to direct investigations towards actions by those in authority at the institute. They demand preservation of evidence and protection for potential witnesses.

title: California Halloween store shooting leaves one dead, six injured; suspect on loose
Udupi man dies by suicide at govt hospital after being thrased by girlfriend's kin
description: Pradeep, a 27-year-old man from Nairkodi, was assaulted by the family of his girlfriend after an alleged altercation. The incident occurred on October 27, when several of the girl's brothers attacked him, causing severe injuries. After being hospitalized due to the assault, Pradeep expressed his distress and received threats from the girl's family. On October 30, Pradeep was found to have died by suicide in the hospital's toilet.

title: Sharmila shifts daughter's wedding venue after brother Jagan's refusal
Greek shipwreck's 2,000-year-old device was built to predict eclipses
description: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. This ancient artifact showcased astounding knowledge of astronomy and mechanical engineering dating back over 2,000 years. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

title: 2,000-year-old Roman face cream found with last user's finger marks
description: In a remarkable find in 2003, archaeologists unveiled a cosmetic cream container dating back almost 2,000 years in London. Composed of animal fat, starch, and tin oxide, this ancient formula likely served as a moisturizer. Researchers painstakingly recreated the cream to explore its texture and look on the skin, shedding light on the beauty rituals of the past and our enduring human connection to history.

title: 'Hurt, but still an admirer: Dipke responds to Diljit's Delhi concert remarks
description: Abhijeet Dipke shared his disappointment regarding Diljit Dosanjh's distancing from a student protest. During a concert, Dosanjh defended his choice to remain silent about social issues. Dipke emphasized his long-standing admiration for Dosanjh despite their disagreement on this matter. Meanwhile, Dosanjh reiterated his commitment to love and support for all Punjabis during his performance. The singer addressed criticisms related to his film 'Satluj' and urged unity among the community.

title: 'Keep Rahul mock PM for life': BJP's dig at INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC
description: BJP national spokesperson Sambit Patra, who is MP from Puri Lok Sabha constituency, called the "mock parliament" a "drama", and highlighted that the Speical Intensive Revision (SIR) was ongoing and substantiated the claims around the "13 crore delted voters". Earlier, Amit Shah challenged the INDIA bloc to discuss the issue during a special session of Parliament.

title: Tata Sons row: ‘Sebi monitoring all developments,’ says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
description: Currently, SEBI is taking charge of governance issues within Tata Sons, the umbrella organization for Tata Group. While Tata Sons is not publicly traded, its subsidiary companies are required to follow SEBI regulations. The regulatory authority has confirmed its vigilant oversight of governance-related events within the group. Additionally, seven listed Tata Group firms have a stake in Tata Sons, and Tata Trusts holds the majority with approximately 66 percent shares.

title: 'UAE se haare': Ex-cricketer 'fact-checks' Pak PM after 'victory over India' post
description: Pakistan beat India in the Hong Kong Sixes on Friday, a six-a-side tournament in which each team bats for six overs. Following the win, Sharif took to social media to praise the team and congratulate the players.

title: INDIA bloc impeachment event: Kharge lists 6 charges against CEC, makes 3 demands
description: Mallikarjun Kharge has initiated a significant public impeachment against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, charging him with vote theft through six detailed allegations, including the controversial deletion of voters and the centralization of electoral authority. The opposition also sought CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal and an end to the SIR exercise.

title: Lost job, sold plants from 600 sq ft flat; now has millions in annual sales
description: Brandon Hurst began his journey into plant selling in 2020 as a side project to boost his income. What started as a small venture has blossomed into a thriving family enterprise, with annual sales surpassing 100,000 plants. Leveraging social media, he incorporated livestream auctions that dramatically boosted profits. Now operating from a vast 3,000-square-foot greenhouse in Los Angeles, Hurst aims to expand while ensuring meaningful connections with his customers.

title: Lebanese couple in tears as buyer vows not to demolish their A$960,000 home
description: In a heartfelt farewell, a Melbourne couple bid adieu to their beloved Maidstone home, a cherished sanctuary for over four decades after immigrating from Lebanon in 1982. Reassured by the buyers' intention to cherish the house rather than demolish it, the couple found solace in their memories. This sale marks a poignant shift as they prepare to embrace a new chapter in Taylors Lakes.

title: How rising rents, living costs are fuelling anger across Europe
description: France is bracing for a wave of protests as widespread outrage over escalating living costs ripples through Europe. Across countries like Greece and Spain, citizens are taking to the streets, raising concerns about housing and wage issues. With minimal income left after covering rent, discontent grows, fueled by stagnating economies and soaring energy prices. Governments find themselves caught between maintaining welfare support and managing financial constraints during these challenging times.

title: 'It’s done bro': J&K CM Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan share photos of their 'new journey'
Man rescued a 2kg bear cub; the 150kg bear still tries to sit on his lap
description: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.

title: INDIA bloc passes 'resolution' to 'impeach' CEC - top developments
13-year-old Goan girl turns backyard moringa into powder business
description: During her summer break, Grace de Souza, a talented teenager from Goa, tapped into her entrepreneurial spirit by producing moringa powder from the leaves of her family's two moringa trees. Her efforts have proven fruitful, with earnings nearing Rs 3,000 from selling 20 packets. Inspired by this success, Grace plans to sustain her small business even when school resumes, embracing the lessons of hard work and responsibility.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.
